transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… I just don’t feel like myself anymore. I used to make time for things—painting, hiking, choir, seeing family on Sundays. Lately, even if I have a free hour, I just kind of sit there. I can’t seem to care about any of it.
How long have you been feeling this loss of interest in things you used to enjoy?
About eight months, I guess. It kind of started building after I took over the STEM-Arts curriculum thing at work.
Do you feel this change in yourself started because of taking over the STEM-Arts curriculum role at work?
Yeah… I think so. It’s hard to say it was just that, but it’s been building for about eight months, around when I took on that STEM-Arts curriculum role.
If the stress at work eased up, do you think you’d still feel this way?

I don’t know. Maybe it would help some, but… what bothers me is I don’t feel like myself anymore. Even when I do have free time, I’m not painting or hiking or going to choir. I just sit there, like I can’t make myself care.
Have you been feeling this way continuously for at least two years?
No… not two years. It’s been more like eight months, since that STEM-Arts curriculum thing started.
Have you been feeling down or depressed معظم الأيام?
Yes… most days. It’s like there’s this gray heaviness over everything. I can be in class with students, or at home with my husband, and still feel kind of hollow… like I’m close to crying.
Has this been making it hard for you to function at work or at home?

Yes… it has. I’ve missed several teaching sessions, and I’ve been avoiding the student workshops because I just can’t seem to keep up like I used to.

At home, my husband’s had to take on more. I kind of pull back from family plans, and… I don’t feel safe trying to just push through it by myself.
Have you been feeling anxious or worried a lot?
I… I’m not really sure. I mean, I worry some, but I haven’t really paid attention to whether it’s a lot.
Have you been feeling anxious most days?
I don’t really know… I haven’t noticed it being most days, exactly. I’m more aware of just feeling low.
Before these past eight months, have you ever had another period in your life when you felt depressed like this for at least two weeks?
I… I’m not sure. I don’t really remember having a stretch quite like this before, at least not that I can clearly point to.
Before this started eight months ago, was there ever a time in your life when you felt depressed like this nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I don’t think so… not that I can really remember. I’ve had rough times, but nothing I’d say was like this nearly every day for two weeks.
Have you had trouble sleeping?
Yes… my sleep’s been pretty bad. I lie awake a lot, going over things in my head, and then I’ll wake up around three or four. Even if I’m in bed longer, I don’t really feel rested.
Have you noticed a change in your appetite?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid much attention to it. I guess nothing that stands out.
During this time, have you been feeling tense or on edge a lot?
I’m not really sure… maybe sometimes, but I haven’t paid much attention to that.
Do you feel the way you’ve been feeling is much stronger than would be expected just from the stress of the new role at work?

Yes… I think so. It doesn’t feel like just work stress. Most days everything feels kind of… gray, like there’s this heaviness over it. Even when I’m with my students or at home with my husband, I can still feel really empty, like I might cry.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Sometimes… late at night, I do think it might be a relief if I just didn’t wake up. I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself, but… the thoughts scared me enough that I told my husband I couldn’t keep dealing with them by myself.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty?

Yes… I guess I have. When something goes wrong with the curriculum project, even small things, I start thinking I’m letting the students down. And then I think about how much my parents gave up for me to have chances like this, and it feels like I’m wasting it.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I’m… not really sure. I mean, I get through things, but I haven’t been paying close attention to whether it’s concentration exactly.
Have you been moving or speaking noticeably more slowly than usual?
I… I don’t really know. I haven’t noticed myself moving or talking slower, but I’m not sure I’d be the best judge of that.
Have you been feeling unusually tired or low on energy?
I’m not sure. I mean… I do feel run down sometimes, but I haven’t really thought about whether it’s unusual or not.
